name: Soyuz-5
about: Soyuz-5 (1969-005A), a crewed vehicle (7K-OK), launched 1969 Jan 15. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1969 Jan 17), held fixed
